method: direct Pavo calls (0 credits) on the same Keeper line, reference storyteller-ref.jpg unless noted, each clip checked with lipsync_check.py (thresholds unchanged: audio >= 0.85, mouth >= 0.45, speak/pause >= 1.5, face >= 0.8)

measurements.variant: run prompt (close-up, slow push-in, leans toward the fire)
camera-facing + reference cropped to head and shoulders
camera-facing + reference cropped to head and shoulders
camera-facing + reference cropped to head and shoulders

conclusions: with the E95 binding the audio is kept every time (0.72-0.99, 10 of 11 >= 0.85)

the lips check passes about 4 times in 10 per generation whatever the variant (run prompt 0 of 4, camera-facing 2 of 4, cropped reference 1 of 3); the misses are a face lost in the fire's deep side shadow and the beard, not a drifting mouth
Pavo copies the reference's framing (medium shot with the scroll) whatever the prompt says, so a close-up word does not enlarge the face; a cropped reference did not help
3 generations per talking shot pass a shot ~78 % of the time and a three-Keeper-shot run ~48 %; 6 generations ~95 % and ~86 %
rules: episode_build TALK_ATTEMPTS = 6 for talking shots (scenes keep 3); plan_check KEEPER_POSE: a talking Keeper prompt says 'static camera' and 'looks straight into the camera'; thresholds unchanged
